```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

rm(list = ls())

dir_path <- "~/Mylab/evogen-sims/FluctSelectionModels.dir/Output.dir/FourSeasFourAmp.dir/"

# Grab all genome* CSVs (e.g., genome1_..., genome2_...)
files <- list.files(
  dir_path,
  pattern = "^genome\\d+_.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

process_file <- function(path) {
  # Extract replicate label from filename, e.g., "genome1"
  replicate_id <- str_extract(basename(path), "genome\\d+")

  # Read + reshape wide (one column per Position)
  geno <- read.csv(path) %>%
    #filter(Generation >= 1500) %>%
    select(-Origin, -Effect) %>%
    mutate(Position = paste0("Pos_", Position)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Position, values_from = Frequency) %>%
    arrange(Generation) %>%
    replace(is.na(.), 0)

  # Build one spectrum per Pos_* column
  spec_list <- geno %>%
    select(-Generation) %>%
    imap(~ spectrum(
      ts(.x, start = min(geno$Generation), frequency = 1),
      method = "pgram", plot = FALSE, spans = c(2, 2)
    ))

  # Tidy: extract freq/spec, convert to period, average across loci
  spec_mu <- tibble(Position = names(spec_list), Spec = spec_list) %>%
    mutate(data = map(Spec, ~ tibble(freq = .x$freq, spec = .x$spec))) %>%
    select(Position, data) %>%
    unnest(data) %>%
   # filter(is.finite(freq), freq > 0) %>%           # avoid 1/0
    mutate(period = 1 / freq) %>%
    filter(period < 40) %>%                         # your cutoff
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(spec_mu = mean(spec, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Replicate = replicate_id)

  spec_mu
}

# Run over all files and combine
all_spec <- map_df(files, process_file)

# Plot: one line per replicate, colored by file/replicate
ggplot(all_spec, aes(x = period, y = spec_mu, color = Replicate)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Period (generations) = 1 / frequency",
    y = "Mean spectral density across loci",
    title = "Averaged periodograms by replicate (period < 100)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
